author: Forbes
description:
Join Forbes Chief Content Officer Randall Lane and Steve Sims, Superintendent of Independence National Historical Park, for a discussion on the enduring legacy of the First Bank of the United States.

Built at the direction of Alexander Hamilton, the First Bank helped lay the foundation for America’s economy and serves as an early example of a successful public-private partnership. Inside this historic landmark, Lane and Sims explore the role of collaboration, stewardship, and shared investment in building institutions that create opportunity and endure for future generations.

From smart "Caper" carts that recognize products in real-time to fixing the dreaded out-of-stock dilemma for grocers, David explains how bridging the gap between online data and in-store physical AI is unlocking a totally new shopping experience.

author: Forbes
description:
Forbes Chief Content Officer Randall Lane introduces the world premiere of the new Ben Franklin rock musical that reimagines Franklin’s life through a modern lens, blending history, innovation, and music. 

Featuring an all-Philadelphia cast and creative team, the production highlights Franklin’s journey from teenage runaway to world-renowned inventor, writer, and statesman. The preview performance showcases original songs inspired by Franklin’s work as “Poor Richard” and “Sound of America” that depict the enduring impact of his ideas on American culture.

Presented in partnership with local organizations and featuring support from Sir Roger Daltrey of The Who, The Sound of America makes its world premiere under the Ben Franklin Bridge as part of Philadelphia’s summer arts season.

What does it really take to build a billion-dollar sales machine — and why does Ryan Serhant still swear by Post-it notes?
